quota.title: Quota: generations and time
quota.intro: What agents have spent, counted in generations and wall time, never money. A toolchain run is one generation; an image tool runs outside the studio, so only the generations an agent declares are counted.

quota.noCeiling: The pack sets no ceiling, so nothing is refused.
